units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 12:1">Lev. R. s. 12</cite> <he>אשקוניה ושַׁכְּרוּנֵיה וכ׳</he> they gave him drink, and made him drunk, and carried him out &c.
<cite ref="Berakhot 9a">Ber. 9ᵃ</cite> <he>אִשְׁתַּכּוּר בהלולא וכ׳</he> they drank freely at the wedding of &c. (and slept beyond the time of prayer).
